business-overview.text: Competition — The food and e-commerce industries in China are highly competitive. We compete with different competitors in each of our business lines. There are certain barriers to entry that have limited the number and success of foreign entrants, emerging, and traditional-cum-emerging brands, including our (i) brand awareness, (ii) E2E supply-chain visibility, (iii) strategic and preferred service agreements with product and distribution partners, (iv) product R&D and go-to-market capabilities, and (v) board of directors and advisory network.

There are certain barriers to entry that have limited the number and success of foreign entrants, emerging, and traditional-cum-emerging brands, including our (i) brand awareness, (ii) E2E supply-chain visibility, (iii) strategic and preferred service agreements with product and distribution partners, (iv) product R&D and go-to-market capabilities, and (v) board of directors and advisory network.

growth-drivers.text: We are a global Asian food platform and digital asset treasury company in China. We have strategically positioned Bitcoin as a core reserve asset while continuing to expand our portfolio of culinary brands. We are at the forefront of public companies integrating bitcoin into our financial architecture. We offer easy, convenient food. They reduce the time and energy needed to prepare a meal at home while never compromising on food safety, variety, and selection.

industry-and-value-chain.text: The increase in total revenue was primarily driven by the expansion of our offline distribution channels and broader retail penetration across our culinary brand portfolio. The growth is attributable to our diversified and solid offline sales channels, which have been optimized and expanded continuously during the first half of 2026, including the increased number in regional distributors and strengthened cooperation with them, driving a steady rise in offline sales volume.

The Company’s shareholders and Board of Directors approved option plans and warrant program in order to provide incentives and rewards to the Company’s employees, directors, consultants and senior management. The cost of share-based compensation also includes options granted related to certain business acquisitions.

moat-and-differentiation.text: We regard our trademarks, copyrights, domain names, know-how, patents, and similar intellectual property as critical to our success, and we rely on a combination of intellectual property laws and contractual arrangements, including confidentiality and non-compete agreements with our employees and others, to protect our proprietary rights As of June 30, 2026, we had registered 279 trademarks, 1 copyright of works and 5 computer software copyrights in China, including three registered trademarks in Hong Kong.

products-and-services.text: We have an omni-channel (online and offline) sales, end-to-end (“E2E”) product development and distribution strategy. We have access to a network of direct-to-consumer (“D2C”) retail, wholesale Point-of-Sales (“POS”), and other corporate partnerships for the offline sale and distribution of our products. We continue to engage and grow our customer-base through curated and relevant video-content, product placement, and a customer-feedback informed product development and distribution strategy.
Unfavorable changes in any of the above factors could adversely affect demand for our products and/or services and impact our results of operations.
